summary: Cellectis S.A. furnished a Form 6-K attaching an Exhibit 99.1 press release dated September 11, 2026 announcing a business-update conference call and webcast scheduled for Monday, September 14, 2026, with English and French sessions plus replay availability. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer notice of an investor communication. It maps to a US Form 8-K Item 7.01-style disclosure. What to watch: the September 14 update's clinical, financing, or partnership detail rather than any deal terms.
